budget_items.what_was_recorded: Committee discussed a part-time, non-benefited 19-hour grant writer position; the Town Manager said it depends on funding availability, and members advocated adding it to the FY 25 budget.
budget_items.quote: when the committee inquired about this possibility the town manager stated it depends on funding availability.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager asked departments for a needs-based budget within the constraint of the allowed year-over-year increase.
budget_items.quote: the town manager requests a needs-based budget and a budget within the constraints of what's being allocated for an increase year over year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The percentage of health insurance received relative to the state average was reported.
budget_items.quote: the percentage received relative to health insurance was 5.7% and the state average is 6.6%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Chair contacted the town attorney about the language and process for a levy override; no reply yet. A member said the town has a millionaire’s tax that drove away revenue meant for schools and infrastructure.
budget_items.quote: evan watters reached out to the town's attorney about the language and the necessary process for a levy override.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager requested a 2.5% school increase; the school department's level increase differential was reported.
budget_items.quote: the town manager has requested a 2.5% increase which totals $575,961.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A member questioned a 66.2% rise in school electricity; the Town Manager was in discussion on the 2024 renewal, with rates expected to fall.
budget_items.quote: chris menard questions why the electricity was up 66.2%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Building maintenance in the school budget was reported up by a stated amount.
budget_items.quote: chris menard asked why the building maintenance was up $100,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Collaborative tuition was reported up, and members asked whether this factors into circuit breaker estimates.
budget_items.quote: additionally, collaborative tuition was up $180,000 and there is question if that factors in any estimates on the circuit breaking.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Members asked why the high school student counselor line item was raised significantly; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: tiffaney tavares asks why the line item for high school student counselor was raised so significantly.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board of Assessors recommended adding money to the overlay account; a member was unclear why, since the account already has a large balance.
budget_items.quote: there was a recommendation to vote to add $122,000 to the overlay account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board of Health budget was reported up by a percentage to a stated total.
budget_items.quote: evan watters states there was a board of health meeting, and the budget was up 10% to $60,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A per-round grant cap for Green Community grants was reported.
budget_items.quote: there is a grant cap of $200,000 per grant round.
